title: A roundup of DLSS 5 developer controls, NVIDIA ACE speech updates, and RTX Kit 2026.3
author: NV_Suroosh
selftext:
Sharing a technical roundup for developers working on neural rendering, in-game AI, or high-density geometry. This blog covers DLSS 5 controls for model selection, structure, tone and masking, with NBA 2K27 as an implementation example; new NVIDIA ACE speech models and local AI inference updates; and RTX Kit 2026.3, including RTX Mega Geometry 2.0 support for streaming continuous level-of-detail clusters.

[https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/whats-new-for-game-developers-dlss-5-with-3d-guided-neural-rendering-nvidia-ace-updates-and-new-rtx-kit-capabilities/](https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/whats-new-for-game-developers-dlss-5-with-3d-guided-neural-rendering-nvidia-ace-updates-and-new-rtx-kit-capabilities/)
